# Firmware parameters

<!-- generated by firmware/tools/gen_docs.cpp from core/lx_params_list.h - do not edit -->

LuxLibre firmware 0.4.0. Every setting of the firmware is a parameter with a name, a range and a default, in the style of ArduPilot. Change them over the console (`set NAME VALUE`, then `save`) on boards that have one, or change the default in the board header (`LX_DEF_...`) and rebuild.

Defaults written as `LX_DEF_...` come from the board header; the value shown is the one of the simulator board.

| Name | Default | Range | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `UI_STYLE` | 0 (`LX_DEF_UI_STYLE`) | 0 ... 2 |  | Button layout: 0 = ramp (smooth dimming), 1 = modes (fixed steps), 2 = simple (modes capped at SIMPLE_MAX, no turbo or blinkies) |
| `PREVIEW` | 1 (`LX_DEF_PREVIEW`) | 0 ... 1 |  | 1 = the light shows the floor level while the button is pressed from off (instant feedback) |
| `CLICK_MS` | 400 | 150 ... 1000 | ms | Longest press that counts as a click, and the longest pause between clicks of one gesture |
| `RAMP_FLOOR` | 1 (`LX_DEF_RAMP_FLOOR`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Lowest level of the ramp (moon); also used for momentary moon |
| `RAMP_CEIL` | 120 (`LX_DEF_RAMP_CEIL`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Highest level reached by holding the button; turbo is above it |
| `RAMP_MS` | 16 | 2 ... 100 | ms | Time per level while ramping (150 levels x 16 ms = 2.4 s for the whole ramp) |
| `MODE_CNT` | 4 (`LX_DEF_MODE_CNT`) | 1 ... 5 |  | Number of fixed modes in the modes and simple layouts |
| `MODE_1` | 30 (`LX_DEF_MODE_1`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Level of mode 1 |
| `MODE_2` | 70 (`LX_DEF_MODE_2`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Level of mode 2 |
| `MODE_3` | 100 (`LX_DEF_MODE_3`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Level of mode 3 |
| `MODE_4` | 120 (`LX_DEF_MODE_4`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Level of mode 4 |
| `MODE_5` | 140 (`LX_DEF_MODE_5`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Level of mode 5 |
| `MODE_MS` | 600 | 200 ... 2000 | ms | Interval between mode steps while the button is held (modes layout) |
| `MEMORY` | 1 | 0 ... 1 |  | Switch-on level: 1 = the last level used, 0 = always MEM_LEVEL (or mode 1) |
| `MEM_LEVEL` | 70 (`LX_DEF_MEM_LEVEL`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Switch-on level when MEMORY = 0 (ramp layout) |
| `TURBO_LVL` | 150 (`LX_DEF_TURBO_LVL`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Turbo level (double click) |
| `TURBO_S` | 60 (`LX_DEF_TURBO_S`) | 0 ... 600 | s | Longest turbo burst before the automatic step-down to TURBO_DOWN; 0 = no time limit (the thermal limit always applies) |
| `TURBO_DOWN` | 120 (`LX_DEF_TURBO_DOWN`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Level after the turbo time has run out |
| `SIMPLE_MAX` | 100 | 1 ... 150 | level | Highest level available in the simple layout (for lending the light to others) |
| `SMOOTH_MS` | 2 | 0 ... 50 | ms | Soft transitions: time per level when the brightness changes; 0 = instant |
| `BLINK_LVL` | 60 (`LX_DEF_BLINK_LVL`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Brightness used for battery and temperature read-outs |
| `BLINKY` | 3 (`LX_DEF_BLINKY`) | 0 ... 7 | bits | Blinky modes after the battery check: 1 = beacon, 2 = SOS, 4 = strobe (add the numbers; 0 = none) |
| `STROBE_HZ` | 10 | 1 ... 20 | Hz | Strobe frequency; flashing between 3 and 30 Hz can trigger photosensitive seizures |
| `LOCK_MOON` | 1 (`LX_DEF_LOCK_MOON`) | 0 ... 1 |  | In lockout, holding the button gives momentary moon (0 = lockout stays completely dark) |
| `AUTOLOCK` | 0 | 0 ... 240 | min | Lock automatically after this many minutes off; 0 = never |
| `POCKET_S` | 30 (`LX_DEF_POCKET_S`) | 0 ... 600 | s | Pocket protection: a button held this long while the main LED is on switches the light off and locks it; 0 = off |
| `AUX_MODE` | 2 (`LX_DEF_AUX_MODE`) | 0 ... 2 |  | Indicator LED: 0 = off, 1 = events and charging only, 2 = also the battery colour for 2 s after switch-on |
| `THM_LIMIT` | 50 (`LX_DEF_THM_LIMIT`) | 30 ... 70 | °C | Temperature the regulator holds (sensor reading + THM_OFFSET); set it so that the hottest touchable surface stays within THM-1 (docs/design-rules.md) |
| `THM_OFFSET` | 0 | -10 ... 10 | °C | Calibration: added to the sensor reading so that it reads the true temperature at the sensor (kept by the factory reset) |
| `THM_KP` | 20 (`LX_DEF_THM_KP`) | 10 ... 20 | 0.1 lvl/°C | Proportional gain of the thermal regulator |
| `THM_KI` | 8 (`LX_DEF_THM_KI`) | 1 ... 12 | 0.1 lvl/°C/s | Integral gain of the thermal regulator (cannot be 0: the regulator always acts) |
| `THM_LEAD` | 4 (`LX_DEF_THM_LEAD`) | 0 ... 10 | s | Prediction: the regulator acts on temperature + rate of rise x THM_LEAD, to make up for sensor lag |
| `THM_FLOOR` | 60 (`LX_DEF_THM_FLOOR`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Lowest level the thermal regulator may force (below it only THM_SHUTDN acts) |
| `THM_UP` | 20 | 1 ... 100 | 0.1 lvl/s | Fastest brightness recovery while the light cools down |
| `THM_SHUTDN` | 75 (`LX_DEF_THM_SHUTDN`) | 40 ... 100 | °C | Hard limit: the light switches off and stays off until 5 degC cooler |
| `BAT_CELLS` | 1 (`LX_BAT_CELLS`) | 1 ... 4 |  | Number of cells in series |
| `BAT_CHEM` | 0 | 0 ... 2 |  | Chemistry for the charge estimate: 0 = Li-ion (3.7 V), 1 = LiFePO4 (3.2 V), 2 = NiMH (1.2 V) |
| `LVP_WARN` | 3200 (`LX_DEF_LVP_WARN`) | 900 ... 3700 | mV/cell | Below this voltage (under load) the light steps down |
| `LVP_CUT` | 2900 (`LX_DEF_LVP_CUT`) | 900 ... 3500 | mV/cell | Below this voltage the light switches off to protect the cell (never below 2700 mV for Li-ion, 2000 mV for LiFePO4, 900 mV for NiMH, whatever is set) |
| `LVP_RESUME` | 3300 | 1000 ... 3800 | mV/cell | After a low-voltage cut-off the light can be switched on again once the cell rests above this |
| `BAT_RINT` | 80 (`LX_DEF_BAT_RINT`) | 0 ... 1000 | mOhm | Resistance of cell, springs and wiring, for the load compensation of the charge estimate |
| `BAT_CAL` | 0 | -300 ... 300 | mV | Calibration: added to the measured pack voltage (kept by the factory reset) |
| `BAT_MAX_MA` | 0 (`LX_DEF_BAT_MAX_MA`) | 0 ... 30000 | mA | Cell current limit, 0 = off (needs the board's LED current model, LX_MAIN_MAX_MA) |
| `CHG_TMIN` | 0 | 0 ... 20 | °C | Charging is paused below this temperature (Li-ion must not be charged below 0 degC) |
| `CHG_TMAX` | 45 | 30 ... 50 | °C | Charging is paused above this temperature |
| `CHG_MAXLVL` | 100 (`LX_DEF_CHG_MAXLVL`) | 1 ... 150 | level | Highest level while USB power is connected |
| `LASER_EN` | 1 (`LX_HAS_LASER`) | 0 ... 1 |  | Allow the laser gesture (click, then click-and-hold from off) |
| `LASER_S` | 60 | 1 ... 300 | s | Longest laser emission per press |
| `LASER_TMAX` | 60 | 30 ... 80 | °C | No laser above this temperature |
| `LASER_VMIN` | 3200 | 900 ... 3800 | mV/cell | No laser below this cell voltage (cheap laser modules drift when the supply sags) |
| `SIDE_RED` | 40 (`LX_DEF_SIDE_RED`) | 1 ... 100 | % | Brightness of the red side light (5 clicks from off) |
| `SIDE_UV` | 100 (`LX_DEF_SIDE_UV`) | 0 ... 100 | % | Brightness of the UV side light; 0 = no UV (two clicks in the side light then do nothing) |
| `COLOR_SET` | 135 (`LX_DEF_COLOR_SET`) | 1 ... 255 | bits | Colours that two clicks step through in the colour beam: 1 = red, 2 = green, 4 = blue, 8 = yellow, 16 = cyan, 32 = magenta, 64 = white from the three colours, 128 = the custom colour COL_R / COL_G / COL_B (add the numbers) |
| `COL_R` | 100 (`LX_DEF_COL_R`) | 0 ... 100 | % | Custom colour: share of the red LED (the strongest of the three runs at the full colour brightness) |
| `COL_G` | 35 (`LX_DEF_COL_G`) | 0 ... 100 | % | Custom colour: share of the green LED |
| `COL_B` | 0 (`LX_DEF_COL_B`) | 0 ... 100 | % | Custom colour: share of the blue LED (red, green and blue all 0 = red) |
